name: Mio Asakura
source:
A new maid that appears during the final stage of the story. With her hands she leads the whole story to a certain end. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
